_comment: Houdini Sportswear sweep 2026-10-18 — every adult style on houdinisportswear.com (Shopify products.json, 728 colourway products → 281 styles) whose description prints a garment weight, plus the Osprey x Houdini Allt 30L, cited to the product page's own 'Weight men's large: …' line. Skipped: styles already in the catalog; kids/junior/baby; Work Hard Pants (fabric weight only); Power Top Hat, Silvestre shoes and the OT care products (no weight); the Message tees (prints of a tee already here at the same weight); Desoli Hat (an older style at the Desoli Thermal Hat's weight); Houdini Cap (no distinguishing name); and seven pages whose size line names the other gender (M's Double Dunfri, Dunfri Guide and Dunfri Parka 'women's medium', W's Moonwalk Vest, Pace Flow Half Zip and Pace Flow Houdi 'men's large', a second M's Power Up Jacket page 'women's medium'). Unisex pieces sized 'men's medium / women's large' are stored as Medium.
